critical quality gate Download ExcelDownload PDF **20** Checkpoints **5** Sections Per subgrade section (typically 1000m² segments) QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 2720:1973](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720-Part-2-1973) [IS 1498:1970](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1498-1970) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) Related [📐IS 2720](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Earthwork Bulking & Shrinka…](https://infralens.in/handbook/earthwork-bulking) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. EXCAVATION & CLEARING | | A1 | Site has been cleared of vegetation, topsoil, and debris to 300mm depth
Acceptance: Complete removal of organic material; visual inspection confirms natural soil exposure | Cl. 401 — Preparation of subgrade | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Excavated subgrade profile matches design cross-section (±50mm)
Acceptance: Spot checks at 100m intervals; variation < ±50mm from design profile | Cl. 401 — Grade compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Soft spots and unstable areas identified and marked
Acceptance: All areas with CBR < 2% identified and documented for special treatment | Cl. 401 — Subgrade stability assessment | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Surface drainage arrangements in place before compaction
Acceptance: Lateral and longitudinal drainage channels provided; no standing water | Cl. 401 — Moisture control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. MOISTURE ADJUSTMENT | | B1 | Soil moisture content adjusted to within ±2% of OMC before compaction
Acceptance: Measured moisture: OMC ± 2%; achieved through watering or aeration | Cl. 401 — OMC compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Uniformly distributed moisture across full width and depth (300mm minimum)
Acceptance: Cross-section moisture variation ≤ 1.5% measured at 3+ locations per section | Cl. 401 — Homogeneous moisture distribution | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Watering/drying completed 24 hours minimum before compaction starts
Acceptance: Moisture equilibration achieved; documented wait period | Cl. 401 — Preparation time | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. COMPACTION OPERATIONS | | C1 | Compaction equipment adequate for soil type (roller weight, vibration frequency)
Acceptance: Roller: static weight ≥10 t; vibratory frequency 30-50 Hz; 3+ passes minimum | Cl. 401 — Equipment selection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Compaction completed in uniform layers of 150-200mm thickness
Acceptance: Each layer thickness: 150-200mm; 4+ passes of roller per layer | Cl. 401 — Layer control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Compaction achieves minimum 95% Modified Proctor density
Acceptance: Field density ≥95% MDD measured by core cutter or sand replacement method | Cl. 401 — Density requirement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Adequate edge compaction with lateral overlap of 0.5m minimum
Acceptance: Roller overlap ≥0.5m on each side; edges compacted to same density as main section | Cl. 401 — Edge control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | No binding or rutting of subgrade surface observed after compaction
Acceptance: Surface rut depth < 25mm; no visible cracks or consolidation failures | Cl. 401 — Surface condition | OK
